assessment: Partial false-positive assessment of original reported records, not a rerun, matched service-defect counts, approved behavior retirement or coverage percentage. Exclude a Swagger record only when EVERY contributing helper occurrence has a same-named PUT candidate whose nonempty differing keys are limited to description/title. Retain mixed occurrences and every other record. TypeSpec does not compare annotations; all its observed presence/body records remain. Other false positives and missing type/version behavior are not resolved by this filter.
identity: Swagger join: exact project + Swagger file + operation diagnostic path + full message; every original record occurs once. Published diagnosticIndex is zero-based in the pinned project diagnostic array; replay indices are zero-based in the pinned replay. No new target grouping, source-location deduplication or cross-engine pairing.
